'''Jaron Janson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 36th at [[2000 Tatooine Regionals]] on 8 July 2000, according to Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1001">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-13-tatooine-regional-07-08-00d1001/ tatooine-regional-07-08-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 13 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-13-tatooine-regional-07-08-00d1001/ GitHub Pages].</ref> On the Players Committee forum he posted as Jerba, signing as Jaron "Jerba" Janson.<ref name="sf-19270-308792">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308792#p308792 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], Jaron Janson (Jerba), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175129/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref> He offered to organize the [[2008 Idaho State Championship]] in Logan, Utah, and proposed Phoenix Games and Comics there as the venue,<ref name="sf-20910-302685">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302685#p302685 Idaho States?], Jaron Janson (Jerba), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183830/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-20910-317126">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=317126#p317126 Idaho States?], Jaron Janson (Jerba), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 July 2008).</ref> and played in it on 9 August 2008,<ref name="sf-20910-317127">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=317127#p317127 Idaho States?], Jaron Janson (Jerba), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 July 2008).</ref> finishing with 6 (+46) among four players; he said it would be his last tournament in Utah for the foreseeable future.<ref name="sf-20910-324490">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=324490#p324490 Idaho States?], Scott Church (CategoryOneGames.com), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 August 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-20910-322805">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=322805#p322805 Idaho States?], Jaron Janson (Jerba), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (8 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125184349/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref>
